android.desc:
This app is easy contacts utility which helps generating and deleting contacts, and pulling DB.

This app is made for the android developers who work with contacts.

I hope this app helps your development, test, and debug. :)

·This app has three main functions: Contacts generation, deletion and pulling DB.

·You can generate random contacts on the specific account you select easily.
  For example, you can generate 1000 random contacts on google account.

·You can delete all contacts on the specific account you select by one click.
  Additionally, you can delete all existing contacts, regardless of accounts, at once.

·You can pull Contacts, RawContacts, Data, and Group database contents to the external storage.

·Every functions are fast and easy to use.
